title_zh: 湖北省武汉市委常委、市委秘书长曾晟接受审查调查
title_en: Zeng Sheng, Member of Standing Committee of CPC Wuhan Municipal Committee and Secretary-General, Under Investigation
summary_zh: 据湖北省纪委监委消息，武汉市委常委、市委秘书长曾晟涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: According to the Hubei Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection, Zeng Sheng, member of the Standing Committee of CPC Wuhan Municipal Committee and Secretary-General, is under disciplinary review and supervision investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.
body_zh:
中新网8月21日电 据湖北省纪委监委消息：湖北省武汉市委常委、市委秘书长曾晟涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受湖北省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
